observations: Bedroom furniture set in a showroom environment.
Large upholstered headboard with integrated curved LED lighting strips.
Bed frame designed for a large mattress (mattress not present).
Two matching bedside cabinets with single drawers and gold-tone accents.
Dresser unit with multiple drawers and a large arched mirror featuring integrated lighting.
A large four-door wardrobe is visible in the background.
The image contains a watermark for 'FURNITURE VENTURES'.
The lighting in the photo appears professionally staged or digitally enhanced.

claims.evidence: Material quality (e.g., solid wood vs. MDF) cannot be confirmed through a photo.

risks.risk: The wardrobe shown in the photo may be excluded as it is not mentioned in the seller's text.
risks.proof: A written confirmation or invoice explicitly listing the wardrobe as part of the sale price.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a 5-piece set (bed, 2 nightstands, dresser, stool) excluding the wardrobe.

risks.risk: The integrated LED lighting may be non-functional or require specialized electrical work.
risks.proof: A video showing the lights being switched on and off in a domestic setting.

risks.risk: The furniture may be constructed from low-grade particle board or MDF rather than durable hardwood.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drawer joinery and the unfinished rear panels of the units.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard MDF/compressed wood furniture.

risks.risk: The photo is a professional showroom shot and may not reflect the actual condition of the item being sold.
risks.proof: Photos of the specific items in their current storage or home location.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used or replica item.

proof_requests: Confirm if the wardrobe in the photo is included in the price.
Provide photos of the furniture in its current location, not a showroom.
Provide a video showing the LED lights on the headboard and mirror working.
Show the inside of a drawer and the back of the dresser to confirm the material.
response.reason: The item is a standard bedroom set. It can be priced based on the components explicitly listed by the seller, assuming the wardrobe is excluded and the materials are basic grade until proven otherwise.
